earnings.title: Contacts: Investors Media
highlights: Global Business Solutions Online Ecosystem Revenue Grew 20 percent; Consumer Revenue Grew 7 percent
Total revenue increased 12 percent to $4.4 billion.
Global Business Solutions revenue increased 15 percent to $3.1 billion.
Consumer revenue increased 7 percent to $958 million.
GAAP operating income increased 63 percent to $868 million.

quotes.text: We delivered a solid first quarter, with results above the top end of our guidance.
quotes.by: Sasan Goodarzi, Intuit’s chairman and chief executive officer

quotes.text: Our first quarter results demonstrate progress against our strategy and reflect disciplined execution.
quotes.by: Sandeep Aujla, Intuit’s chief financial officer

items.heading: We face intense competitive pressures that may harm our operating results.
Future revenue growth depends upon our ability to adapt to technological change and successfully extend our platform, introduce new and enhanced products, features, services and business models.
Our intellectual property rights are valuable, and any inability to protect them could reduce the value of our products, services and brand.
Our business depends on our strong reputation and the value of our brands.
Our efforts related to sustainability matters expose us to risks that could adversely affect our reputation and performance.
Our acquisition and divestiture activities may disrupt our ongoing business, may involve increased expenses and may present risks not contemplated at the time of the transactions.
